headline: Nevish Line Flares With Fresh Base Exchanges Amid Heavy Clashes
war_summary: Combat along the Nevish Line has erupted into rapid movement with six base exchanges logged over the past two hours, generating more than sixteen hundred combined casualties across Blackcoat Way and Grief Mother. In Weathered Expanse, the furious base-swapping from earlier editions has noticeably cooled, recording three exchanges as casualty rates dropped sharply. Linn of Mercy continues as an intense attritional grinder, consuming nearly seventeen hundred troops over two hours around Lathair without further ground changing hands. Stlican Shelf has re-entered the active column with two base transfers and heavy fighting claiming over eleven hundred casualties, while Marban Hollow marked two fresh turnovers near Checkpoint Bua. Skirmishing in Callahan's Passage is accelerating with over eight hundred recent losses, whereas Kuura Strand and Godcrofts have settled into tactical standstills following earlier disruptions. Across the broader map, the Dead Lands and rearward provincial sectors remain quiet with minimal enemy contact.
